_comment: P2.6 box 1 leftover: the wrap-or-rotate rule for long upright category labels, shared by calc.figure_category_axis.fit_category_labels and frontend lib/statMarks.fitCategoryLabels. Each case measures a label as char_w per code point and a line as line_h tall (the canvas's monospace estimate; each side substitutes its own text metrics at run time), against a slot `pitch` in the same unit. An explicit rotation/wrap wins; else upright when the widest label fits its slot; else wrapped (LABEL_WRAP_WIDTH 12, at most 3 lines, no line cut) when every wrapped line fits; else rotated 45 when the pitch is at least line_h*sqrt(2), 90 below that.

cases.name: a label exactly as wide as its slot fits
too wide, wraps within three lines that fit
a wrapped line still too wide: rotate 45
needs four lines to wrap: rotate 45
one long word hard-splits into three fitting lines
